services.name: St. Pete Pier to Egmont Key Tour
services.desc: The Pelican is the only ferry service from downtown St. Pete to Egmont Key! Duration 4 Hours About Sit back, relax and enjoy your the 60-minute ride from the Pier to Paradise. You’ll sail by the beautiful shorelines of St. Pete, pass under the stunning Sunshine Skyway bridge and perhaps see a dolphin or two! You will have approximately 2 hours on Egmont Key to explore the pristine beaches, historic lighthouse, ruins of Ft. Dade, and the amazing wildlife before your return trip. Weather conditions + travel time will determine exact time on Egmont Key. More Information 60 foot, 49 passenger boat You will have to step into shallow water when going on the island.
